reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and firstWeekdayOccurrence and adds one isNonWorkingDay predicate that replaces every d.isWeekend weekend check in schedules code.

duplication.why: The non-working-day rule is defined once, but holidays has to be threaded by hand through the daily-skip vs move dispatch that getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template each still make themselves (that repetition was already there).

placement.why: The predicate and the move logic live in shared/schedules.ts, the field on RecurConfig, and the parsed recurrence data in rule-utils.ts where skipWeekend is already carried.

scope.why: Every edit carries the holidays field or uses the new predicate; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clean shared predicate and a general step-until-working-day loop, but the helper keeps a weekend-only name and getDatesInRange's `3 + holidays.length` padding is an ad hoc bound.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate/firstWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts, and schedule-template.ts
